name: Memories of No One
source:
A young boy ventures to a bridge which is isolated from his town, only to discover somebody is there. 

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=8096]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一个小男孩冒险来到一座与他的城镇隔离的桥上，却发现有人在那里。

[来自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=8096]引理软论坛[/url]]
